messages.subject: Parameters value on each node
parts:
Hello Nick

I estimated ancestral area using DEC + j after comparing it with other models. My question may be naive but how do I get the influence of parameters on each node, that is, if in a node "x" the event "j" was the the greatest influence on probability?

Thanks,
Chico

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Parameters value on each node
parts:
Hi -- the question lacks meaning as you have posed it.  Probably you just mean "what's the chance of a jump-dispersal/founder-event speciation event at node x"?  Except in the simplest cases (e.g. where the probability is 0 or 1), you will need to do biogeographical stochastic mapping:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#stochastic_mapping
http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeographical-stochastic-mapping-example-script

...and then count up the frequency of each event at that node...

Cheers!
Nick
